land.text: the old cora of Sidonia round Arcos: 'Cádiz, Qalšāna, Jerez and Arcos', Medina Sidonia (Cliopatria 4,920 km2)

predecessors.note: The Banu Jizrun, a Zanata Berber family, 'seized the cora of Sidonia' after expelling the Umayyad governor; 'Arcos became an independent Moorish taifa in 1011 during the protracted collapse of the Umayyad Caliphate' (city page).

successors.note: The second taifa (1143-1145) was 'finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate'; the Seville and Almoravid interval (1068-1143) is shown in the ledger.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the page has the taifa arise in 1011 ('giving rise to the kingdom Taifa of Arcos in 1011') and its first ruler from 1011/2; Cliopatria starts in 1015. Shape unchanged; the infobox gives no area, so Cliopatria's 4,920 km2 is unchecked.

4,920 km2 round Arcos: matches the city page's territory ('the old cora of Sidonia: Cádiz, Qalšāna ... Jerez and Arcos'; 'Medina Sidonia, Arcos and Cádiz') in kind; no page gives an area or a boundary.
4,995 km2: the same land with a few cells' difference; the page records no gain or loss during Muhammad I's or 'Abdun's reigns.
4,945 km2: unchanged; no page records a change of land in 1040. The city page's statement that Seville took Arcos in 1053 does not alter the outline, only its owner (see the 1066 verdict).

correction.text: unchanged outline, years 1066-1068 only; Seville's from 1068 (or 1053 on the city page)

keyframe_review.note: 5,020 km2: right for 1066-1068 only. The Taifa page has the first period run 'from 1011 to 1068' and then 'under the forcible control of Seville' (Abbad II al-Mu'tadid) until 1091; the Taifa overview table has 'Arcos: 1011-1068 (to Seville)'. The city page, however, says al-Mu'tadid 'took over Arcos and its taifa from a Berber chief in 1053'. 1068 is kept (two pages, and a list of rulers to 1068/9), so Cliopatria's 1069-1071 is Seville's.

New keyframe: the page has Arcos regain 'its independence from 1143 to 1145', after Seville (1068-1091) and the Almoravids (to 1143); Cliopatria has no shape after 1071. The outline is the 1066 shape; the page gives the ruler Abu'l-Qasim Ahyal 'also in Jerez', which is inside that outline.

region.text: the old cora of Sidonia round Arcos: 'Cádiz, Qalšāna, Jerez and Arcos', Medina Sidonia (Cliopatria 4,920 km2)

ledger.note: 1011: the Banu Jizrun found the taifa of Arcos. 'giving rise to the kingdom Taifa of Arcos in 1011, with its capital in the present city of Arcos de la Frontera', led by Muhammad I; they 'seized the cora of Sidonia' after expelling the Umayyad governor. Cliopatria starts in 1015.

1068: Seville takes Arcos. The first period ran 'from 1011 to 1068' and from 1068 to 1091 the kingdom was 'under the forcible control of Seville', held by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid (the overview table: 'Arcos: 1011-1068 (to Seville)'). The city page puts al-Mu'tadid's takeover 'from a Berber chief in 1053'; Cliopatria keeps an Arcos shape to 1071.

1143: Arcos is independent again. The page: the kingdom passed to the Almoravids and 'regained its independence from 1143 to 1145'; it gives the Almoravid span as 1101-1143 while the city page has the Almoravids overtake the region in 1091.
1145: the Almohads take Arcos. The restored taifa was 'finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate' in 1145 (the page then lists the Almohads as rulers to 1248).
1145: the taifa of Arcos ends under the Almohads (see the loss event); Ferdinand III took possession of Arcos in 1250 and Alfonso X reduced it in 1264 (city page).

wars.name: Seville's takeover of Arcos
wars.outcome: Seville ended the Jizrunid taifa: in 1068 on the Taifa page, in 1053 on the city page.
wars.note: Neither page describes a campaign or a battle; the war name is the researcher's. Reviewer eu-12-g (2026-10-25): span narrowed from 1053-1068 to 1068: the Taifa page lists Muhammad II al-Qaim as ruler of Arcos '1053-1068/9' and has the first period run 'from 1011 to 1068', so no Sevillan war covered 1053-1068; the city page's 1053 stays in the outcome and the 1068 ledger note.

wars.name: Almohad conquest of Arcos
wars.outcome: The Almohads conquered the restored taifa in 1145.
wars.note: No campaign is described; the span starts with the restoration in 1143.

certainty.note: The pages name the cora of Sidonia and a few towns (Arcos, Jerez, Medina Sidonia, Cádiz), not a frontier.

notes: Cliopatria rows: all four shapes are one outline (4,920-5,020 km2) for 1015-1071 and the row stops in 1071 although the pages carry the taifa to 1068 and again 1143-1145; years 1069-1071 are Seville's. The pages disagree on when Seville took Arcos: 1068 (Taifa page, overview table) or 1053 (city page). Not settled (page silent): the frontier of the taifa (the pages list the cora of Sidonia, Jerez, Cádiz, Medina Sidonia); who held Arcos 1068-1143 beyond 'Seville' and 'the Almoravids' (the Taifa page says the Almoravids 1101-1143, the city page 1091); alliances with Morón and Carmona (no page mentions them). The infobox gives no area. Mirrors needed: Seville (gain 1068), almoravid-dynasty (loss 1143), almohad-caliphate (gain 1145). Gazetteer names needed: Arcos de la Frontera, Jerez de la Frontera, Medina Sidonia (places in Cádiz province).
